0000.png.text: With Code Scans, you point Devin at a repository with one goal, and it reads the whole codebase and turns what it finds into findings you can fix.

0010.png.text: You describe what you want to find, Devin chooses the scan type from your request, and you confirm the repositories on its setup card.

0020.png.text: The scan runs unattended, reads through the code, and lists what it finds in the scan's Findings tab.

0030.png.text: Assign a finding to Devin, and it starts a session that fixes it and opens a pull request for you to review.

0040.png.text: Once a scan completes, Scan new commits runs it again on only the commits added since the last run, and adds the new findings to the same scan.

0050.png.text: There are scan types for performance, database queries, test coverage, dead code, accessibility, compliance and more, plus a custom scan for anything else you describe.
